span.p: 🏦 App Ngân hàng Khách hàng (Quét VietQR)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cloudflare Edge Network / Vercel Edge Cache
- SSL/TLS Termination
- DDoS Mitigation & Web Application Firewall (WAF)
- Static Asset Caching (JS/CSS/Next.js Images)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Node.js Serverless Functions (Next.js 16 App Router)
- Edge Middleware (Session & RBAC Guard)
- API Handlers (/api/orders, /api/webhooks, /api/admin)
- Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & Dynamic Streaming

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🐘 Managed PostgreSQL (Neon / Supabase)
- Connection Pooling
- ACID Transactions
- Prisma Engine Integration

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚡ Upstash Serverless Redis
- Catalogue Query Caching (TTL)
- Distributed Rate Limiting
